Path 1, deliveryGOALS §1.6

Stakater Reloader

Restart what consumes a ConfigMap or Secret when it changes.

WHAT IT IS

A small controller that watches ConfigMaps and Secrets and triggers a rolling restart of the Deployments, StatefulSets and DaemonSets that reference them.

WHAT SETS IT APART

Annotation-driven and tiny, with no sidecar. The alternative is hash-annotation tricks in every chart, which teams forget.

WHERE WE STAND

Adopt first. Without it a GitOps config change appears to succeed while pods keep serving the old value.

ArgoCon; our own brainstorm

ADOPT

Stakater Reloader: Restart what consumes a ConfigMap or Secret when it changes. Where we stand: Adopt first. Without it a GitOps config change appears to succeed while pods keep serving the old value. The cheapest item on the path, and it protects the 'Git is the state of the world' claim.
